- For each product and order pair, it calculates the number of distinct unit prices (`numOrders`) and the range of unit prices (`priceRange`) between the minimum and maximum unit prices among those orders.
- The results are ordered in descending order based on `priceRange`, so products with the largest variations in unit price come first.
- Finally, we limit the result to the top 3 products.
